name: Discontinuity Reduction via Fixed-Point Iteration
definition: A post-processing step applied to intersection points retrieved by sphere tracing to smooth out discontinuities in the signed distance function f(p) and reduce artifacts in procedural texturing. It uses a fixed-point iteration scheme to find points satisfying a specific error condition.
summary: Discontinuity Reduction via Fixed-Point Iteration smooths intersection points to reduce visual artifacts, trading slight geometric error for significantly reduced discontinuities.
